name: Xi'an Sinofuse Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Xi'an Sinofuse Electric Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of fuses and related accessories in China. The company offers electronic fuses, power fuses, pyro fuses, smart fuses, relays, and current sensors. It also provides solutions, such as new energy vehicle, charging infrastructure, wind power, electrochemical energy storage, solar power, data centers. The company products are used for new energy vehicles, energy storage, data centers, solar and wind power, eVTOL, industrial control, and rail transit. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Xi'an, China.
